links.outcome: Run-to-run consistency of LLM diagnostic outputs across two independent runs per model-case pair
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 showed the lowest run-to-run mean difference and highest run-to-run correlation, indicating numerically greater stability; differences between models were modest.
links.quote: DeepSeek-V3 also showed the lowest run-to-run mean difference and the highest run-to-run correlation, indicating numerically greater stability.

unlisted_practices: ICD-10-CM hierarchical scoring framework for open-ended diagnosis evaluation
Restricting benchmark cases to post-cutoff publications to reduce training-data leakage

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance and consistency of multiple LLMs (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) on 50 clinical vignettes using an automated hierarchical ICD-10 evaluation framework, without testing a deployment guardrail or human-in-the-loop practice.
